Riya: pic drop! Lola found the warm spot behind the toaster and made a bed. https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F12345/lola_toast.jpg :joy: she's shaped like a tiny slice of toast.

Jesse: hahahaha loaf mode engaged :loaf:

Ava: that's the coziest toaster I've ever seen. does she have a tiny chef hat? :chef:

Marta: pls tell me the toaster is unplugged :sweat_smile:

Riya: unplugged & cold now, she just likes the vent warmth. vet said soft warm spots are fine. :relieved:

Zane: 10/10 interior design. shipping to my place? :smile:

Ava: quick poll — does Lola get the first piece of breakfast toast? :raised_hands: 1) yes  2) cuddles only

Jesse: `/:one:` votes yes

Marta: `/:two:` votes cuddles only

PollBot: Poll created: "Lola gets toast?" Options: Yes / Cuddles only — Current: Yes 1, Cuddles only 1

Riya: update — she also stuck her head in the crumb tray for a sec, removed crumbs immediately :see_no_evil: will post two more pics later tonight. adorable overload. :sparkles:
